areas.label: Contact
areas.question: Can strangers message or voice chat with your child, is it on by default, and can it be turned off?

areas.label: Money
areas.question: Does it push in-app purchases, loot boxes, pay-to-win or subscription traps?

areas.label: Data
areas.question: What does it collect, does it track for ads or share with third parties, and can the data be deleted?

areas.label: Age gating
areas.question: Does the age gate work in practice, going by what parents report?

areas.label: Content
areas.question: What do reviewers actually report seeing?

areas.label: Developer record
areas.question: Has the developer had fines, breaches, lawsuits or regulatory actions?
